label: DisasterReady India - Evacuation Routes & Citizen Safety
title: DisasterReady India - Evacuation Routes & Citizen Safety
prompt:
Public Citizen Safety & Evacuation Navigation (P2, P5, P6, P7, P8, P10, P11 in spec).
Header with orange flood warning alert: 'Move to higher ground now. Rani river is above danger level at Kharadi. Water is rising. Official CWC & DDMA (Updated 4 min ago)'.
Core interactive layout:
1. Four clear action tiles: 'Get to safety' (#/safety), 'Ask for relief supplies' (#/supplies), 'Check my request' (#/track), 'Emergency helpline 112'.
2. Live Interactive Map Graph (Nadipur District SVG canvas viewBox 0 0 100 100): Nodes N1 Gandhi Chowk, N2 Hanuman Temple, N3 Canal Rd underpass, N5 Ring Rd jct, N6 Hill Rd jct, N7 Market Rd, N8 Govt Girls High School (S1), N9 Ward 9 Hall (S2), N10 Sonpur Shelter (S3), N11 District Hospital (H_A), N12 CHC Mohanpur (H_B).
3. Hazards with hatched pattern fills and status badges: H1 Flooded Canal Road (0.8m depth, Official), H2 Damaged Ring Road Bridge (closed, Official), H3 Water-logging Temple Rd (0.2m, Unverified), H4 Landslide-prone Hill Road.
4. Route Comparison Card & Table (Section 5.1): Route A (Shortest: 18 min, 1.4km, High hazard), Route B (Safest & Recommended: 24 min, 2.1km, Low hazard, avoids flooded underpass), Route C (Alternative: 28 min, 2.4km, None).
5. 'Why this route?' factor breakdown and time window countdown ('Likely to flood further in 40 min. Leave within 25 min').
6. Shelters & Hospital ranking cards with live capacity ('Govt Girls High School: 140 of 500 left - Space Available', 'Sonpur Shelter: Full').
7. Hazard reporting form ('Report hazard / road closure') and 'What Changed' twist preview panel (Route B blocked -> switches to Route C, +4 min).
8. Accessible transit-line progress motifs, 'Listen' read-aloud buttons, and text size / high-contrast toggles. All matching the exact transit-signage design system.
